items.title: Europe's financial regulators query Google over cloud outage that hit banks
paras: Listen Reuters FILE PHOTO: FILE PHOTO: 3D printed clouds and figurines are seen in front of the Google Cloud service logo in this illustration taken February 8, 2022. Financial regulators in Europe are questioning Google after a cloud computing outage on Tuesday left millions of bank customers without access to key financial services for hours.

Alphabet's Google said the disruption, which lasted several hours, was caused by a "power event" in a London-based network that serves customers across Europe. Revolut, Lloyds and HSBC were among the banks affected. Lloyds and HSBC did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

items.title: Outback giant yabby Australia's latest 'big thing'
paras: The yabby has become a symbol for the town of Windorah. A 4.6-metre yabby statue has been unveiled in Windorah, western Queensland. A history lecturer says Australia's "big things" industry has become professionalised.

Australia's "big things" are a common sight on a road trip, dotting highways and country towns, and a Queensland town has just added its own. A giant yabby statue now stands in Windorah, 1,200 kilometres north-west of Brisbane. The big yabby was unveiled during a ribbon-cutting ceremony on Albert Street. It is a fitting addition to the town with a population of 100, best known for hosting "international yabby races", Barcoo Shire Mayor Sally O'Neil said.
